description: This file defines a React component named ShelfModal that provides a modal dialog interface to add a shelf with a name. It manages user input, validates shelf name length, and communicates with a backend API to save the shelf, displaying success or error messages accordingly.

classes.name: ShelfModal
classes.description: A React component that renders a modal dialog for adding a new shelf.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component state and binds event handlers.

methods.name: handleChange
methods.description: Updates the state with the current value of the shelf name input field.

methods.name: submitShelf
methods.description: Validates input length and posts the new shelf to the backend API, updating UI based on success or failure.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the modal UI including input field, buttons, and alerts.
